moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day
moments.blurb: Today marks the thrilling conclusion of The Hundred 2026 cricket tournament, with both the men's and women's finals taking place at Lord's.

angles.name: Finals excitement
angles.copy: It all comes down to today! The Hundred Finals are LIVE from Lord's, with Trent Rockets battling for both men's and women's titles. Who are you backing?

angles.copy: The Home of Cricket is buzzing! Lord's hosts The Hundred finals today – get down there or tune in for a massive day of action.
